sentences: Both assignments run together so a[0] gets a[2] and a[2] gets a[0] in one step.
The swap happens all at once, so a[0] becomes 3 and a[2] becomes 1 together.
First line changes a[0] to a[2] value while the next line changes a[2] to a[0] value at the same time.
Since they happen together, a[0] takes 3 and a[2] takes 1, giving me {3, 2, 1}.
The two assignment lines execute side by side, so both values exchange without one happening before the other.
